```yaml
name: Build Linux No-Container

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        required: true
        type: string
      python_version:
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda_version:
        required: true
        type: string
      runner_label:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      wheel_path:
        description: Path to the built wheel
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.wheel_path }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_label }}
    outputs:
      wheel_path: ${{ steps.wheel_location.outputs.wheel_path }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python_version }}

      - name: Build Flash Attention
        id: build
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-and-upload
        with:
          platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}
          cuda_version: ${{ inputs.cuda_version }}
          python_preference: only-managed

      - name: Locate wheel
        id: wheel_location
        run: |
          wheel=$(find dist -name "*.whl" | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$wheel" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up build artifacts"
          rm -rf flash-attention
          rm -rf venv
          rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
          rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
          rm -rf /usr/local/cuda
```
